summary: Changed the default Claude model from claude-opus-5 to claude-opus-5-5 in the three permitted files: src/sensei_top/llm/config.py (DEFAULT_MODEL constant, so the env-key/no-model path now defaults to claude-opus-5-5), src/sensei_top/review/narrative.py (its own DEFAULT_MODEL), and src/sensei_top/cli.py (the --set-model help string now reads "e.g. claude-opus-5-5"). llm/client.py was deliberately not touched, so claude-opus-5 remains a known, priced model, and a model set in config.toml still overrides the default. Both checks passed on the last run: uv run pytest -q tests/test_llm.py (83 passed) and uv run ruff check . (All checks passed).
